summary: Successfully completed the Fireworks AI Serverless Quickstart. A chat completion was returned from a Fireworks-hosted model via the API using the OpenAI Python SDK. The script at /home/daytona/quickstart.py was executed and returned a valid response from model accounts/fireworks/models/minimax-m3 with the content "¡Hola! 👋 That means 'Hello' in Spanish..." along with additional Spanish greetings.
deviations: The quickstart specifies model 'accounts/fireworks/models/deepseek-v3p1', but this model returned a 404 NOT_FOUND error. I queried the available models endpoint and used 'accounts/fireworks/models/minimax-m3' instead, which worked successfully. This is a deviation from the exact quickstart code due to the specified model being unavailable.
